title: Process TOC
description: Convert index.html to toc.md and convert to md format.
success_criteria: Replace the unordered lists with indented markdown bullet points in toc.md
All TOC indents are determined from the autonumbering depth in index.html rather than inferred from HTML heading tags
Remove autonumbering preceding heading titles in toc.md. Do not remove any numbers that are part of the heading titles themselves.
toc.md uses markdown formatting and links
No broken links remain in toc.md.
Replace __160 and similar non-breaking-space artifacts in toc.md with normal spaces so heading links render correctly.
All H1 parent entries with no autonumbering are flush-left in toc.md with no indentation before the markdown bullet.
notes: Completed. cleaned_html/Basic HTML/index.html now emits toc.md in markdown bullet-link format, with index.md retained as a compatibility alias.
